title: Propulsion Assignment
description: Design and analyze a rocket propulsion system for a small satellite launch vehicle. Include calculations for thrust, specific impulse, and fuel efficiency.

title: Combustion Analysis
description: Perform a detailed combustion analysis of a liquid rocket engine. Analyze the combustion chamber pressure, temperature, and efficiency.

title: Nozzle Design Project
description: Design an optimized nozzle for a rocket engine. Include calculations for expansion ratio, exit velocity, and thrust coefficient.

title: Aerodynamics Quiz
description: Complete a comprehensive quiz covering fundamental aerodynamic principles including Bernoulli's equation, lift and drag forces, and flow patterns.

title: Flow Analysis
description: Analyze subsonic and supersonic flow over an airfoil. Calculate lift coefficient, drag coefficient, and pressure distribution.

title: Heating Analysis
description: Study aerodynamic heating effects on a re-entry vehicle. Design a thermal protection system and calculate heat transfer rates.

title: Structural Design Task
description: Design the structural framework for a small spacecraft. Include stress analysis, material selection, and safety factors.

title: Orbital Calculations
description: Calculate orbital parameters for a satellite mission. Include orbital velocity, period, and transfer orbit calculations.

title: Systems Engineering Exam
description: Comprehensive exam covering spacecraft systems integration, testing procedures, and mission planning.

title: Organic Synthesis Lab Report
description: Write a detailed lab report on the synthesis of an organic compound. Include reaction mechanisms, yield calculations, and spectroscopic analysis.

title: Reaction Mechanism Worksheet
description: Complete a worksheet analyzing various organic reaction mechanisms. Include arrow-pushing diagrams and intermediate structures.

title: Stereochemistry Assignment
description: Analyze stereochemical properties of organic compounds. Identify chiral centers, draw stereoisomers, and predict optical activity.

title: Coordination Compounds Lab
description: Synthesize and characterize a coordination compound. Analyze its structure, bonding, and spectroscopic properties.

title: Crystal Field Theory Problems
description: Solve problems related to crystal field theory. Calculate crystal field splitting energies and predict magnetic properties.

title: Organometallic Chemistry Essay
description: Write an essay on the applications of organometallic compounds in catalysis. Include specific examples and reaction mechanisms.

title: Thermodynamics Problem Set
description: Solve problems involving the laws of thermodynamics. Calculate entropy changes, Gibbs free energy, and equilibrium constants.

title: Kinetics Experiment
description: Conduct a kinetics experiment to determine the rate law and activation energy of a chemical reaction. Analyze experimental data and write a report.

title: Quantum Chemistry Calculations
description: Perform quantum chemistry calculations using computational software. Analyze molecular orbitals and predict molecular properties.

title: Elvish Translation Exercise
description: Translate a passage from English to Sindarin and Quenya. Include grammatical analysis and cultural context.

title: Dwarvish Runes Project
description: Create a document written in Dwarvish runes. Include transliteration and translation with cultural commentary.

title: Language Analysis Paper
description: Write an analytical paper comparing the linguistic structures of Elvish, Dwarvish, and the Black Speech. Discuss their historical development and cultural significance.

title: Council of Elrond Analysis
description: Analyze the diplomatic strategies employed during the Council of Elrond. Discuss the roles of different races and the decision-making process.

title: Alliance Formation Essay
description: Write an essay on the formation of alliances in Middle-earth. Focus on the relationships between Elves, Men, and Dwarves during the Third Age.

title: Diplomatic Crisis Simulation
description: Participate in a simulation of a diplomatic crisis in Middle-earth. Write a reflection paper on conflict resolution strategies and outcomes.
